items.title: Zcash’s landmark NU7 upgrade goes live, speeding up private payments
items.snippet: NU7 cuts the target time between blocks to 25 seconds, reduces the work wallets must do to find private payments and sets aside fees for future miners.

items.title: Crypto exchanges tout cold storage ratios after Binance attack
items.snippet: Coinbase says it keeps more than 99% of customer assets offline, while Gate reports 88.26% of its total assets are kept in cold storage.

items.title: Core Scientific to quit Bitcoin mining by year-end as AI business surges
items.snippet: The former Bitcoin mining heavyweight plans to become a pure-play data center provider in 2027, with mining now accounting for just 7.5% of quarterly revenue.
